We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (ID 1914385) to the molecule given: initial_molecule SMILES: COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O

We have template search result: mapped_rxn and template_id. The mapped_rxn is a reaction SMARTS? It includes atom mapping. The template ID is 1914385. We need to apply this template to the target molecule to get precursors.

We have tool apply_template which takes molecule_smiles and template_id. So we can call apply_template with the SMILES and template_id "template_1914385"? The tool expects template IDs like "template_123". But we have numeric ID. Possibly we need to use the exact ID string? The description: template_id: string, examples "template_123". So we may need to prefix "template_"? Not sure. The template ID from search is 1914385 (int). Might need to convert to string "1914385". Let's try apply_template with template_id "1914385".
